subject: BOA
author: Jinno Angelo
body:
"me i haven't really found a racing game that grabs you by the testes and holds on 'til the finish line.It puts you in a good mood and rocks you...I LOVE IT"

That sums it up cause if Burnout grabs you by the balls and holds on to it for dear-life traveling at 300 on a jump and till the finish line, you know you just got hooked....Play both Revenge and Paradise, me personally I like Revenge better, and see if those games will get you going.
